name: Smart Calculator Builder With Google Sheets – Build Interactive Calculators with Google Sheets at Backend
author: Hayat Developers | Smart Cost Builder With Google Sheets Lite - Made for WordPress

sections.description:
Whether you need to build cost calculators, pricing tables, or database apps for searching datasets, this plugin offers a versatile solution to display real-time data on your WordPress site. By connecting directly to your Google Sheets, create custom dynamic cost calculators effortlessly with a user-friendly drag-and-drop interface.

Integrating seamlessly with Google Sheets for powerful backend calculations using text fields, checkboxes, select options etc. The Smart Cost Calculator Builder With Google Sheets offers a wide range of result elements, including images, tables, charts, read-only inputs, and dynamic paragraphs. These elements can display content fetched directly from Google Sheets, providing a dynamic and interactive experience for your users.

Key Features:

  • Drag-and-Drop Builder: Quickly design custom calculators with an intuitive interface.
  • Google Sheets Integration: Directly connect your calculators to Google Sheets for live data processing.
  • Formula Fields: create calculators without any Excel or Google Sheet.
  • Input-Free Calculators: Create calculators that display data without requiring user input.
  • Customizable Inputs: Choose from various input types like text fields, checkboxes, and dropdowns.
  • Dynamic Result Display: Present results in formats like charts, tables, and images.
  • Real-Time Data Sync: Ensure your calculators always display the latest data from your Google Sheets.
  • No Coding Required: Build powerful calculators with zero coding knowledge.
  • Flexible Output Mapping: Easily map results from Google Sheets to your calculator display.
  • Responsive Design: Your calculators will look great on any device.
  • Create Database Apps: Build searchable database apps for querying datasets in Google Sheets.

Complete Documentation:

For a comprehensive guide on how to get the most out of the Smart Cost Calculator Builder With Google Sheets plugin, including detailed instructions, advanced features, and troubleshooting tips, visit our complete documentation. Whether you’re just getting started or looking to explore more advanced capabilities, our documentation has everything you need to build powerful and dynamic calculators with ease.

View the Smart Cost Builder Documentation

What kind of calculators, I can create with this plugin?

You can create a wide variety of calculators tailored to almost any industry. The key advantage is that if you have a working knowledge of Google Sheets or Excel, you can easily set up custom calculators for your specific needs.

Here are some examples of calculators you can create:

  • Monthly Loan Payment Calculator Use this template
  • Crypto Selling Calculator Use this template
  • Auto Loan Calculators (Comming Soon)
  • Pregency Calculator (Comming Soon)
  • Shipping & Delivery Cost Calculator (Comming Soon)

How to convert my existing excel sheet to web calculator using smart cost calculator builder plugin?

Step 1: Upload your Excel sheet to Google Drive.

Step 2: Open the file in Google Drive and choose “Save as Google Sheet” to convert it.

Step 3: Update the sharing settings of your Google Sheet to “Anyone with the link can edit” to allow the plugin to access the data.

Step 4: Follow the same procedure described in the video to integrate your Google Sheet with the Smart Cost Builder plugin and create your web calculator.

sections.installation:
Installing the plugin is simple:

  1. Install via WordPress Admin Panel:
    • Go to Plugins -> Add New -> Search for “Smart Cost Calculator Builder With Google Sheets,” then click Install.
  2. Install via ZIP File:
    • Download the ZIP file and upload it through WordPress Admin -> Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin, then browse and upload.
  3. Manual Installation:
    • Extract the ZIP and upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/ via FTP.
  4. Activate the Plugin:
    • Go to the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress and activate it.
sections.faq:
Can I create a calculator without user inputs?

Yes, you can create input-free calculators that only display data from Google Sheets, perfect for showing real-time updates without user interaction. See Documentation here

How can I customize the appearance of my calculator?

You can customize the calculator’s appearance by adjusting colors, fonts, and layout elements to perfectly align with your website’s design using the plugin’s built-in settings. See Documentation here

Can I create calculators for any industry?

Yes! The plugin is versatile and allows you to build calculators for any industry, whether it’s finance, education, healthcare, or beyond.

Do I need any coding skills to use this plugin?

No coding skills are required. The drag-and-drop interface makes it easy for anyone to create calculators without technical expertise.

How will I embed the calculator on my website?

Embedding your calculator is simple—just copy the shortcode provided by the plugin and paste it where you want the calculator to appear on your website.

Can I customize the look and theme of the calculator?

Yes, the plugin offers extensive customization options, enabling you to personalize the calculator’s colors, fonts, and design to match your site’s theme.

What is the datatable feature?

The datatable feature allows you to create interactive tables with options for pagination, search, and filtering, making it ideal for showcasing large datasets from your Google Sheets or Excel files.

Can I manage leads and orders directly from my account?

Yes, you can manage and track leads and orders captured through your calculators and forms directly from your account dashboard. See Documentation here
